title.value:
Predicting Tactical Solutions to Operational
Planning Problems under Imperfect Information
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote:
Predicting Tactical Solutions to Operational
Planning Problems under Imperfect Information

extractions.description: The paper addresses the problem of predicting tactical descriptions of operational solutions (TDOSs) in two-stage stochastic programming, where the second stage is computationally demanding. It proposes a methodology that combines machine learning and operations research to quickly predict expected TDOSs, conditionally on the first stage variables. The motivating application is load planning for rail transportation.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing operational planning problems using machine learning and operations research techniques. While the application is in rail transportation, the core focus is on improving computational efficiency and prediction accuracy rather than directly addressing broader sustainable development goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This paper offers a methodological contribution at the intersection of machine learning and operations research. Namely, we propose a method-ology to quickly predict expected tactical descriptions of operational solu-tions (TDOSs).

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on improving the efficiency and accuracy of operational planning using machine learning techniques. While the application domain is in rail transportation, the paper does not directly address any of the predefined climate or ecologically-related sustainable development categories.

applications.value: Commercial transportation- optimize freight routing and scheduling
applications.justification: The paper uses load planning for rail transportation as a motivating application, which falls under the optimization of freight routing and scheduling.
applications.quote: Results on our motivating application on load planning for rail transportation show that deep learning models produce accurate predictions in very short com-puting time (milliseconds or less).

applications.value: Grid optimization (scheduling)-grid becomes complex due to uptake of EV and renewables
applications.justification: The optimization of railway operations can contribute to grid optimization by enabling more efficient transportation of goods, potentially reducing the need for energy-intensive alternatives.
applications.quote: To illustrate the methodology, we specialize the two-stage booking prob-lem to reflect the booking decisions made about the shipment of intermodal containers by rail at our industrial partner. In this case, the operational bin packing problem is the so-called load planning problem (LPP) where containers are loaded optimally onto double-stack railcars (Mantovani et al., 2018).
